operations.name: Ryan Johnson

expected.charges: Military prosecution following unauthorized absence and refusal of Iraq deployment; exact plea specifications unverified
expected.sentence: A supporter reported his court-martial, ten-month sentence and actual imprisonment in October 2016. A March 2017 campaign update describes continuing confinement at Miramar and visits from his wife. An October 2017 report confirms release and resettlement. The earlier predicted May release is not entered as an actual date.

updates.charges: Missing movement and remaining away from the military for 4,175 days; guilty plea at a special court-martial at Fort Irwin, California
updates.sentence: A supporter reported his court-martial, ten-month sentence and actual imprisonment in October 2016. A March 2017 campaign update describes continuing confinement at Miramar and visits from his wife. An October 2017 report confirms release and resettlement. The earlier predicted May release is not entered as an actual date. The Nuclear Resister (June 8, 2017, p.4) reports a September 26, 2016 guilty plea at Fort Irwin to missing movement and remaining away for 4,175 days, followed by a ten-month sentence. It reports release by publication but supplies no exact release date. The plea date is not independently established as the sentencing or prison-admission date.

operations.source: The Nuclear Resister, no.185, June 8, 2017, page 4, Military Refuser Ryan Johnson Released (original PDF retained locally: tmp/nuclear-review/newsletters/nr185.pdf).
